name: Prototype Sky Striker Ace – Spectra
effect:
1 "Sky Striker Ace - Purple Danya"
Must be Link Summoned.
You can only Special Summon 1 “Prototype Sky Striker Ace – Spectra” per turn.
This card is treated as "Sky Striker Ace – Purple Danya" and is unaffected by your opponent’s card effects.
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 “Sky Striker” card from your Deck, GY, or banished zone to your hand. You can only activate this effect of “Prototype Sky Striker Ace – Spectra” once per Duel.
Quick Effect: You can target 1 card on the field; banish it, and if you do, this card loses 500 ATK. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this effect. You can only activate this effect of “Prototype Sky Striker Ace – Spectra” twice per Duel.
